body.statement: If \(h_{x,y}|_{T(S)}\in\operatorname{row}_{\mathbb Q}(B)\), then a rational vector \(\lambda\) satisfying \(\lambda B=h_{x,y}|_{T(S)}\) exists and \(\tau_{x,y}(\theta)=F_{\lambda}(P_{\theta})\) for every \(\theta\in\Theta_S\). The expression has a rational-coefficient numerator over a denominator dividing \(D_S(P)\), and \(D_S(P)>0\) throughout \(\operatorname{relint}(\Delta(S))\).
body.justification: Success must yield one evaluable formula valid everywhere on the face, not a numerical singleton test.
body.gap: Arithmetic-circuit invariant cuts and credal singleton computations are instance certificates; the common denominator and face-wide rational identity are the additional output here.
body.consumer: The functional can be evaluated, differentiated, audited symbolically, and passed to a support-scoped identification engine.
